title: Locate active 3EN Security Monitor GUI v3
description: Read-only Windows-side discovery for the active 3EN Security Monitor GUI. Uses non-regex path filtering to exclude agent runs/backups, locates candidate GUI/source/data files and running processes, searches for block/unblock, multi-select, blacklist, history and 3en-threats.json references, and creates a timestamped backup copy of candidate source files. No application logic is changed.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $BackupRoot=Join-Path 'C:\3EN-Agent\backups\016b' $stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BackupRoot | Out-Null; Set-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-016b-current.txt' -Value $BackupRoot -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$BackupRoot); Write-Host 'BACKUP_016B_READY'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $BackupRoot=(Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-016b-current.txt' -Raw).Trim(); Write-Host '=== 3EN SECURITY MONITOR SOURCE DISCOVERY 016B ==='; $roots=@('E:\skrypty','C:\3EN-Agent',([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')),([Environment]::GetFolderPath('MyDocuments')))|Where-Object{$_ -and (Test-Path $_)}|Select-Object -Unique; Write-Host '=== RUNNING CANDIDATE PROCESSES ==='; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'python|pythonw|powershell|pwsh|node|3en' -and $_.CommandLine -match '3en|security|monitor|threat|block' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | Format-List | Out-String -Width 500 | Write-Host; $all=@(); foreach($root in $roots){ $items=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { -not ($_.FullName -like 'C:\3EN-Agent\runs\*' -or $_.FullName -like 'C:\3EN-Agent\backups\*') } | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 5MB } | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '(?i)(3en|security.?monitor|threat|blocklist|blacklist)' -or $_.Extension -in '.py','.ps1','.js','.html','.htm','.json','.css' }; $all += $items }; $all=$all|Sort-Object FullName -Unique; $candidates=@(); foreach($f in $all){ $match=$false; if($f.Name -match '(?i)(3en|security.?monitor|threat|blocklist|blacklist)'){$match=$true}; if(-not $match -and $f.Extension -in '.py','.ps1','.js','.html','.htm','.json'){ try{$txt=Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction Stop; if($txt -match '(?i)(en3_block4|3en-threats|security-monitor|unblock|blacklist|blocklist)'){$match=$true}}catch{} }; if($match){$candidates += $f} }; $candidates=$candidates|Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending -Unique; Write-Host '=== CANDIDATE FILES ==='; $candidates|Select-Object -First 120 FullName,Length,LastWriteTime|Format-Table -AutoSize|Out-String -Width 300|Write-Host; Write-Host '=== BACKUP CANDIDATE SOURCES ==='; $n=0; foreach($f in ($candidates|Select-Object -First 80)){ if($f.Extension -in '.py','.ps1','.js','.html','.htm','.json','.css','.txt'){ $n++; $dest=Join-Path $BackupRoot ('{0:D3}_{1}' -f $n,$f.Name); Copy-Item -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Destination $dest -Force -ErrorAction Stop } }; Write-Host ('BACKUP_COUNT='+$n); Write-Host '=== SYMBOL SEARCH ==='; $patterns=@('en3_block4','3en-threats','security-monitor','unblock','blocklist','blacklist','selected','selection','multi','history','manual'); foreach($f in ($candidates|Select-Object -First 80)){ if($f.Extension -notin '.py','.ps1','.js','.html','.htm','.json','.css','.txt'){continue}; try{$lines=Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -ErrorAction Stop}catch{continue}; $hits=@(); for($i=0;$i -lt $lines.Count;$i++){ foreach($p in $patterns){ if($lines[$i] -match [regex]::Escape($p)){ $hits += [pscustomobject]@{Line=$i+1;Text=$lines[$i].Trim()}; break } } }; if($hits.Count -gt 0){ Write-Host ('--- FILE '+$f.FullName+' ---'); $hits|Select-Object -First 80|Format-Table -AutoSize|Out-String -Width 500|Write-Host } }; Write-Host '=== EXACT DATA FILE SEARCH ==='; foreach($root in $roots){ Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -File -Recurse -Filter '3en-threats.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { -not ($_.FullName -like 'C:\3EN-Agent\runs\*' -or $_.FullName -like 'C:\3EN-Agent\backups\*') } | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-List | Out-String -Width 300 | Write-Host }; Write-Host 'DISCOVERY_016B=PASS'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $b=(Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-016b-current.txt' -Raw).Trim(); if(-not(Test-Path $b)){throw '016b backup directory missing'}; Write-Host ('BACKUP_EXISTS='+$b); Write-Host 'VALIDATION_016B=PASS'
rollback: Write-Host 'READ-ONLY DISCOVERY TASK: no rollback required; backup copies only.'
